Load packages

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rprojroot)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Seurat)
  library(patchwork)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(SeuratExtend)
})

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "tcell-trajectory-analysis")
downstream_tcell_results_dir <- file.path(
  root_dir,
  "analyses",
  "downstream-analyses",
  "results",
  "tcell"
)
results_dir <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "results",
  "combined-tcell-trajectory"
)
plot_dir <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "plots",
  "combined-tcell-trajectory"
)

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Source trajectory helper functions
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "tcell_trajectory_helpers.R"))

# Analysis parameters
subtype_label <- "tcell"

Load tcell object

input_rds <- "cart_tcell_subtypes.rds"
input_path <- dplyr::case_when(
  file.exists(file.path(downstream_tcell_results_dir, input_rds)) ~
    file.path(downstream_tcell_results_dir, input_rds),
  file.exists(file.path(data_dir, input_rds)) ~ file.path(data_dir, input_rds),
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (is.na(input_path)) {
  stop(
    "Input RDS was not found. Run downstream-analyses/06-tcell-reclustering.Rmd ",
    "or download data/v5 before running this module: ",
    input_rds
  )
}

cat("Reading:", input_path, "\n")
## Reading: /home/rstudio/haydar-scrna/analyses/downstream-analyses/results/tcell/cart_tcell_subtypes.rds

Slingshot for Pseudotime Analysis

traj_obj <- subset(
  tcell_obj,
  subset = !tcell_subtype %in% c(
    "Antigen-presenting myeloid cells",
    "NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes"
  )
)
traj_obj[["CCA20"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = Embeddings(traj_obj, "integrated.cca")[, 1:20, drop = FALSE],
  key = "CCA20_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(traj_obj)
)

traj_obj <- RunSlingshot(
  traj_obj, 
  group.by = "tcell_subtype", 
  reducedDim = "CCA20",
  start.clus = "Naïve / central-memory T cells")

Slingshot lineage curves on UMAP

sling_res <- traj_obj@misc$slingshot$CCA20

# Pseudotime matrix from Slingshot
sling <- sling_res$SlingPseudotime
pseudotime_cols <- colnames(sling)

# UMAP coordinates + metadata + pseudotime
umap_df <- Embeddings(traj_obj, "umap") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell")

colnames(umap_df)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

umap_df <- umap_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    traj_obj@meta.data %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      dplyr::select(
        cell,
        tcell_subtype,
        seurat_clusters,
        condition,
        dplyr::all_of(pseudotime_cols)
      ),
    by = "cell"
  )

subtype_levels <- levels(droplevels(umap_df$tcell_subtype))

if (is.null(subtype_levels)) {
  subtype_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(umap_df$tcell_subtype)))
}

subtype_colors <- setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(length(subtype_levels)),
  subtype_levels
)

# Make UMAP curves for all lineages
curve_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  pseudotime_cols,
  paste0("Lineage ", seq_along(pseudotime_cols)),
  ~ make_umap_curve_from_pseudotime(
    umap_df = umap_df,
    lineage_col = .x,
    lineage_name = .y,
    approx_points = 150
  )
)

# Approximate lineage nodes as subtype centroids among cells assigned to each lineage
lineage_node_df <- make_lineage_node_df(umap_df, pseudotime_cols, min_cells = 10)

# Endpoint labels for overview plot
lineage_endpoint_df <- curve_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage) %>%
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

lineage_arrow_df <- make_lineage_arrow_df(curve_df)

# Overview plot
p_slingshot_overview <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = tcell_subtype),
    size = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, group = lineage),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.1,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = lineage_arrow_df,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, xend = UMAP_1_end, yend = UMAP_2_end),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.1,
    lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = grid::unit(0.18, "inches"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lineage_node_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = lineage_endpoint_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, label = lineage),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fill = ggplot2::alpha("white", 0.85),
    label.size = 0.18,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"),
    point.padding = grid::unit(0.35, "lines"),
    box.padding = grid::unit(0.5, "lines"),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey45",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    force = 3,
    force_pull = 0.2,
    max.iter = 10000,
    max.time = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 1234
  ) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = subtype_colors, breaks = names(subtype_colors), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(color = "T cell subtype") +
  ggtitle("Lineage curves on UMAP")

p_slingshot_overview

ggsave(

)

Fast pseudotime differential expression screen

genes_to_test <- VariableFeatures(traj_obj)

pseudotime_gene_screen <- purrr::map_dfr(
  pseudotime_cols,
  ~ fast_spearman_pseudotime_test(
    seu = traj_obj,
    pseudotime_col = .x,
    features = genes_to_test,
    min_detected_frac = 0.02
  )
)

utils::write.csv(
  pseudotime_gene_screen,
  file.path(results_dir, "tcell_slingshot_fast_spearman_pseudotime_gene_screen.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

top_pseudotime_genes <- pseudotime_gene_screen %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_adj)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = p_adj, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

Gene trend curves and heatmaps

gene_trend_curve_plots <- list()
gene_trend_heatmap_plots <- list()

for (lineage_name in pseudotime_cols) {
  
  top_genes <- get_top_pseudotime_genes(
    pseudotime_gene_screen,
    lineage_name,
    n = 40
  )
  
  if (length(top_genes) == 0) {
    next
  }
  
  top_curve_genes <- head(top_genes, 12)
  lineage_pseudotime <- as.data.frame(sling[, lineage_name, drop = FALSE])
  
  p_curve <- GeneTrendCurve.Slingshot(
    traj_obj,
    features = top_curve_genes,
    pseudotime.data = lineage_pseudotime,
    method = "smooth",
    point = FALSE,
    se = FALSE,
    ncol = 4
  )
  
  print(p_curve)
  gene_trend_curve_plots[[lineage_name]] <- p_curve
  
  p_heat <- GeneTrendHeatmap.Slingshot(
    traj_obj,
    features = top_genes,
    pseudotime.data = "CCA20",
    lineage = lineage_name,
    scale = TRUE,
    sort = TRUE
  )
  
  print(p_heat)
  gene_trend_heatmap_plots[[lineage_name]] <- p_heat
}
